copy.facebook:
We’ve all seen it: the student who spends three days proofreading for typos but still walks away with a 54%. It’s a bitter pill, but the difference between a mid-range grade and a First Class isn't spelling—it’s substantive editing.

THE 54% TRAP: Relying purely on basic grammar checkers that overlook weak topic sentences, contradictory claims, and unformatted citation pinpoints. You’re essentially polishing a house with a cracked foundation.

THE 78% BLUEPRINT: Substantive developmental editing. This is where you audit your work for academic register, restructure paragraphs to ensure your argument flows logically, and align every claim directly with your module rubric.

If you’re ready to stop guessing and start hitting those higher grade bands, our postgraduate team is here to help. We don't just proofread; we show you how to elevate your writing style to meet university expectations.
